verdict.headline: Batches of this blend were recalled overseas for ethylene oxide
verdict.summary: Regulators in two jurisdictions withdrew specific batches of this masala blend after detecting ethylene oxide, a pesticide not permitted on spices in the EU. A separate sampling report found pesticide residue above the Indian permitted limit. Check the batch code on your pack against the list below before using it.

findings.title: Ethylene oxide detected above the EU maximum residue limit
findings.detail: A border-control sampling of this blend reported ethylene oxide at 0.24 mg/kg against an EU limit of 0.1 mg/kg. The notification covers the batch codes listed here; packs outside these batches were not part of the withdrawal.

citations.label: RASFF 2024.XXXX
citations.excerpt: ethylene oxide (0.24 mg/kg - ppm) in spice blend from India

findings.title: Voluntary withdrawal ordered by an overseas food safety authority
findings.detail: The importing country's centre for food safety instructed distributors to stop sale and remove affected lots from shelves, citing the same contaminant.

citations.label: CFS Food Alert FA-XXXX
citations.excerpt: The Centre for Food Safety today instructed the trade to stop sale of the affected batches.
